title: Tickets to Tokyo
topic: A Friday 12:35 AM departure treated as Friday night
blurb: A friend just booked a cheap red-eye and is planning the send-off.
prompt: A friend just texted this in the group chat. If one line doesn't add up, tap it.

segments.label: The find
segments.text: Grabbed a cheap flight to Tokyo leaving at 12:35 AM on Friday the 14th.

segments.label: Time off
segments.text: I finish work Thursday afternoon, so I don't even have to take PTO.

segments.label: The plan
segments.text: Since it's past midnight, I'll head to the airport Friday night after dinner and sleep on the plane.

segments.label: The lock-in
segments.text: Tickets are non-refundable, so I'm booking it now.

conclusion: It's after midnight, so Friday night after dinner still makes the 12:35 AM Friday flight.

flaws.original: 12:35 AM Friday is Thursday night — just after midnight. I'll go to the airport after work on Thursday.
flaws.corrupted: Since it's past midnight, I'll head to the airport Friday night after dinner and sleep on the plane.

diagnosis_choices.label: 12:35 AM Friday is Thursday night. Show up Friday after dinner and the plane is already in Tokyo.
A 12:35 AM departure still counts as Thursday, so they do need to take Friday as PTO.
International flights board two hours early, so Thursday afternoon is already too late.
Saturday in Shibuya is impossible; Tokyo is a day behind, not a day ahead.

fix_choices.label: Go Thursday night after work. Friday 12:35 AM is that same night, not the next evening.
Take Friday off as well, then go Friday night as planned.
Move the booking to Saturday 12:35 AM so the Friday-night send-off still works.
Arrive Saturday morning and sleep at the airport, since red-eyes always land a day later.

flaws.explanation: 12:35 AM Friday is Thursday night. Show up Friday after dinner and your plane is already in Tokyo.
flaws.why_tempting: The ticket says Friday, and 'past midnight' sounds like the end of Friday. It's easy to slide the whole night forward a day.
flaws.catch_rule: A 12:35 AM Friday flight is the night after Thursday — not Friday evening.
flaws.hint: When is 'Friday 12:35 AM' if you start counting from Thursday evening?

practice.problem: A concert is listed as 12:10 AM Saturday. A friend says, 'Great, we can have a full Saturday and go that night.' What's wrong?
practice.answer: 12:10 AM Saturday is Friday night, just after midnight — not Saturday evening.

clean_segments: Grabbed a cheap flight to Tokyo leaving at 12:35 AM on Friday the 14th.
I finish work Thursday afternoon, so I don't even have to take PTO.
12:35 AM Friday is Thursday night — just after midnight. I'll go to the airport after work on Thursday.
Tickets are non-refundable, so I'm booking it now.
clean_conclusion: 12:35 AM Friday is Thursday night. Go after work on Thursday, not Friday evening.
